text:
Maria (partnerships): Quick sync — want to align on the ISV/tooling preflight for next Tue's joint demo. Main things: LangChain runner test, LlamaIndex connector stability, gateway adapter smoke, marketplace listing assets, and hardware partner perf numbers. Who can own which?
Samir (eng): I can take LangChain runner test. Need a minimal harness and sample workflows.
Julia (platform): I'll pick up LlamaIndex connector smoke tests + gateway adapter end-to-end. Can we get a sample dataset?
Tony (pm): I can handle marketplace assets + joint announcement draft. Also let's lock the demo narrative: 3-min flow that shows failover to lightweight model when dedicated capacity is saturated.
Maria (partnerships): Perfect. @Samir can you confirm test harness by EOD Fri? We should surface any model variant compatibility issues.
Samir (eng): Yeah. Plan: create a small harness that runs 3 flows: retrieval+compose, agent loop, and streaming output. Will post raw logs to the cloud bucket. ETA: Fri 6pm PT.
Julia (platform): For dataset — can we use the sanitized customer-support corpus from the sandbox? It's already in S3: s3://redwood-internal/samples/support-sanitized. Will that work?
Tony (pm): That works. For announcement, we'll need 2 screenshots, one short GIF of the failover, and a one-paragraph partner quote. I'll draft and share in #marketing by Mon.
integration-bot: CI results for langchain-runner: 2/7 flaky tests failing. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/7723
Samir (eng): On the 2 flakes — looks like a timing issue with the streaming socket. I can add retry logic and a CI run.
Maria (partnerships): Ok, action items recap:
- Samir: LangChain harness + fix flakes + CI green by Fri (owner)
- Julia: Connector smoke + gateway e2e + sample dataset hookup (owner)
- Tony: Marketplace assets + announcement draft + GIF (owner)
- Maria: Coordinate partner comms and schedule demo rehearsal Thu afternoon
Can we each drop a short status update in this thread when done? :thumbsup:
Samir (eng): Will update here when CI is green.
Julia (platform): Starting smoke tests now, will post results.
Tony (pm): Draft going to marketing, will ping for approvals.
Maria (partnerships): Also asking HW partners for perf numbers — @Tony can you include a one-liner ask for the exact metric (p99 latency, tokens/sec, GPU mix)?
Tony (pm): Yep — will request p50/p95/p99, batch sizes used, and GPU type.
integration-bot: Reminder: partner NDA doc v2 was updated yesterday. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/partners/nda-v2
Maria (partnerships): Great catch. Make sure legal is cc'd on the announcement.
Samir (eng): CI passed after retry fix. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/7723#passed
Julia (platform): Connector smoke passed, gateway e2e shows one routing edge-case when KV cache misses spike. Working on a mitigation — small TTL bump fixes locally.
Tony (pm): Marketing asked for final assets by Mon 10am PT. I'll aim for that.
Maria (partnerships): Thanks team. I'll schedule rehearsal Thu 3pm PT and invite partners. If anything blocks earlier, flag here. :rocket:
